sections.body: Estimate your care use for the year. Add each plan’s premium to its likely out-of-pocket costs. Check that your doctors and drugs are covered. The cheapest premium often loses on total cost for regular care users. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.
